comments.content: `Database` is used (new Database(...)) but never imported. Sibling modules import it as `import { Database } from "bun:sqlite";` (see src/health.ts:5, src/preview.ts). As written, any commit that reaches the sqlite block throws ReferenceError: Database is not defined, which is swallowed by the outer `catch {}` so the best-effort store silently fails. Add `import { Database } from "bun:sqlite";` at the top.
